# MellowMill Studio
> Privacy-first, local-first productivity workspace for busy professionals, sole traders, and small business owners.

## Core Summary
MellowMill Studio is a local-first application that consolidates notes, tasks, projects, and deadlines into a single, cohesive workspace. It features bring-your-own AI integration, zero data scraping, and a one-time lifetime access payment model.

## Primary Specifications
- **Architecture**: Local-first storage (files remain on user's machine)
- **Data Format**: Custom plain text format called Margin (but it is Markdown compatible)
- **Key Modules**: Task-driven notes, project scopes, deadline tracking
- **AI Capability**: Bring-Your-Own AI agent integration
- **Pricing**: One-off payment for lifetime access and all future updates (No recurring subscriptions)

## Key Technical Differentiation
Unlike cloud-dependent SaaS productivity tools, MellowMill prioritizes absolute data ownership. It operates directly on local files, preventing vendor lock-in, eliminating forced cloud syncing, and ensuring total privacy for sensitive client or business logs.
